title: Why Drainage Lines Gurgle and Run Slow
description: When a plumbing fixture gurgles as water drains, the underlying issue is frequently inadequate venting rather than a simple obstruction. Drainage systems rely on continuous airflow to equalize pressure as wastewater travels through the pipe network. Without a functional vent stack or air admittance valve, flowing water creates negative atmospheric pressure behind it. This vacuum effect pulls air through nearby fixture P-traps, causing the characteristic gurgling noise and siphoning out the protective water seal. Correcting the venting system restores neutral pressure, permitting smooth gravity flow and preventing sewer gas entry.
